lines.t: Our voice cries together, whether they hear
Let hearts be quickened, or let them forbear
Come stand with me a moment
Close enough to feel my breath
You stayed, one other scattered
Unflinching at what comes next
You shed all bitter ignorance
Your close distance knots your eyes
You already merged our sorrows
From tears shed through the night
I brought you beyond surprise
Beyond toil, away from blame
You're here because I love you
And you feel the very same
So blow the trumpet with me
With heartache and truth
Sound the warning call of love
As mercy's solemn proof
Our voice cries together
Whether they hear
Let hearts be quickened or let them forbear
I send my servants to lead my words clear and true
Through lives they overlook, through warnings they push through
You watched them twist my mercy
Truth trampled, set aside
You felt how long awaiting
Let the innocent die
You know this isn't sudden
No fury breaking free
Let's break the silence
Let me shatter their cruelty
So blow the trumpet with me
Let compassion lead the sound
The final plea to turn back home before the lost abound
Our voice cries together, whether they hear
Let hearts be quickened or let them prevail
I'd take no pleasure in the ending of those who won't choose life
I'd wait until love was tested beyond what patience could strive
For mercy without repentance shelters the oppressor's sword
I will not betray the helpers by delaying justice anymore
Stay locked in with me, you'll never stand apart
This warning rises from grief that long has broke our heart
Our voice cries together, whether they heed it
Let hearts be quickened or let them fall bare
You cannot fail, you cannot fall
The trumpet sounded clear as love giving o'er
Warm them for me, beloved
Warn them for me
We'll see you next time.
Thank you.
